intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “I haven’t forgotten what you asked me. Or why I couldn’t say yes.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “You want to be a person beside me. Not a role I protect, or show off.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Yes. And I still need you to mean it.”

options.labelText: “I want to marry the person you are when nobody’s watching. We choose our future together. Would you still want that?”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “And not one numbered point. Who are you?”

options.labelText: “Marry me, and I promise you’ll never have another bad day.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Never? That’s a promise nobody can keep.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “I’ve met days, {PLAYER}. They don’t take orders.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She waits to see whether you’ll try again.
